entities.name: Amrou Haven
entities.description: Former paradise homeland of the kithkin on western Jamuraa, destroyed in the apocalypse.

entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: People whose homeland was Amrou Haven, scattered after its destruction.

events.summary: Amrou was destroyed in the apocalypse and the kithkin were scattered across the salt steppes and the Maumiwu Wastes.
events.quote: Once a paradise, Amrou was destroyed in the apocalypse and the kithkin were scattered across the salt steppes and the Maumiwu Wastes of Dominaria during the Rift Era.

relations.quote: Amrou Haven (AM-roo ) was the homeland of the kithkin on Dominaria .
